_about: The installers' look, defined once (deployment plan: 'Installer look and feel'). scripts/gen-brand.cjs writes it into packaging/linux/install.sh and packaging/windows/opspoint.ps1; tests/packaging.test.js fails when they drift. Colours come from the OpsPoint icon: a navy disc, a silver ring, an open door lit gold.

navy.role: Background, panels (the disc and the door)

gold.role: Titles, the selected item, progress fill (the doorway light)

warm.role: Highlights, links, the setup code (the glow on the floor)

pass.role: A check that passed (never a brand colour)

fail.role: A check that failed (never a brand colour)

menu.question: What would you like to do?

words.openSetup: Open this link to finish setup
words.phoneNote: Scan it with a phone to finish setup there
